about: Batch 04, slice A, chunk A48: Mediterranean-diet, lightened comfort, fakeaway, BBQ, one-pot and freezer-to-table dinners.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Tuna, Lemon and Cherry Tomato Spaghetti
recipes.summary: Pantry spaghetti with tinned tuna, cherry tomatoes, garlic, lemon and parsley.
steps: Boil the spaghetti for 10 minutes until al dente and keep half a cup of the water.
Fry the garlic and chilli in half the oil for 1 minute, add the tomatoes for 6 minutes until they burst, then flake in the tuna and heat for 2 minutes.
Toast the breadcrumbs in the remaining oil for 3 minutes until golden. Toss the pasta with the sauce, lemon and parsley and a splash of water, and top with the crumbs.
notes: Contains fish and gluten. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chicken with Olives, Lemon and Potatoes
recipes.summary: Tray-roasted chicken legs with potatoes, green olives, lemon and thyme.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chicken, potato, oil, lemon, garlic, thyme and salt on a large tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, then add the olives and tomatoes and roast for 15 minutes more until the skin is crisp and the chicken reaches 75°C.
Serve straight from the tray with the pan juices.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C at the thickest part with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Mediterranean White Bean and Vegetable Stew with Gremolata
recipes.summary: Cannellini beans, zucchini and tomato stewed with garlic and finished with lemony parsley gremolata.
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 6 minutes, add two-thirds of the garlic and the rosemary for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, beans, stock and salt and simmer for 15 minutes, adding the zucchini for the last 8 minutes, until thick.
Mix the parsley, lemon zest and remaining crushed garlic and scatter over the stew.
notes: Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 4 days.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Baked Eggplant with Chickpeas and Feta
recipes.summary: Roasted eggplant halves filled with tomatoey chickpeas and crumbled feta.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Score the eggplant, brush with two-thirds of the oil and roast cut-side down for 25 minutes until soft.
Soften the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, chickpeas and salt and simmer for 10 minutes until thick.
Turn the eggplant over, fill with the chickpeas, top with feta and bake for 10 minutes until golden.
notes: Contains milk. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Grilled Fish with Tomato and White Bean Salad
recipes.summary: Lemony grilled fish over a salad of tomato, white beans, red onion and basil.
steps: Rub the fish with half the oil, half the lemon juice and the garlic. Grill for 4 minutes a side until it flakes easily.
Toss the beans, tomato, onion and basil with the remaining oil, lemon juice and salt.
Serve the fish over the salad.
notes: Food safety: fish should be opaque and flake easily, reaching 63°C; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains fish.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Lamb and Vegetable Souvlaki Bowls
recipes.summary: Oregano lamb with roast vegetables, quick tzatziki and rice in a satisfying bowl.
steps: Marinate the lamb in two-thirds of the oil, oregano, half the garlic, lemon juice and salt for at least 30 minutes.

Grill or pan-fry the lamb for 8 minutes, turning, until browned and 71°C inside, and roast or fry the zucchini and capsicum in the remaining oil for 10 minutes. Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender.
Squeeze the cucumber dry and mix into the yoghurt with the remaining garlic. Serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces should reach 71°C with no pink; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Lightened Butter Chicken with Cauliflower Rice
recipes.summary: All the creamy tomato flavour of butter chicken with yoghurt and less butter, over cauliflower rice.
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yoghurt, half the garam masala and the paprika for at least 30 minutes.

Cook the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, add the garlic, ginger and remaining garam masala for 1 minute, then the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Blend until smooth and add the chicken, simmering for 10 minutes until it reaches 75°C. Stir in the remaining yoghurt and the cream.
Fry the cauliflower in a dry pan for 5 minutes until tender, season with the salt and serve under the curry.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: Lightened Creamy Chicken and Leek Pasta Bake
recipes.summary: A comforting bake of chicken, leek and pasta in a light yoghurt-milk sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Boil the penne for 8 minutes until just tender and drain.

Cook the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes, add the leek and garlic for 5 minutes, stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes until thick. Off the heat, stir in the yoghurt and mustard.
Fold through the pasta, tip into a dish, top with the cheese and breadcrumbs and bake for 15 minutes until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains gluten and milk.

recipes.title: Fakeaway Chicken Doner Kebab Plates with Chilli Sauce
recipes.summary: Spiced chicken thigh grilled until charred, served with salad, chips and garlic chilli sauce.
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the yoghurt, the cumin, paprika, two-thirds of the garlic and the oil for at least 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and roast the chips with the 2 tablespoons oil for 30 minutes until golden. Grill or fry the chicken for 10 minutes until charred and 75°C inside.
Mix the remaining yoghurt, garlic and chilli sauce. Serve the chicken with the chips, cabbage, tomato and onion and drizzle with sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 2 days.
Contains milk.

recipes.title: BBQ Teriyaki Salmon Skewers with Sesame Rice
recipes.summary: Glazed salmon skewers grilled for a few minutes and served over sesame rice with cucumber.
steps: Simmer the soy sauce, honey, vinegar and garlic for 3 minutes until syrupy and cool. Toss half with the salmon and thread onto skewers.
Cook the rice for 12 minutes until tender and stir through the sesame seeds. Grill the skewers over medium-high heat for 5 minutes, turning and brushing with the glaze, until the fish flakes.
Serve over the rice with cucumber and spring onion and drizzle with the remaining glaze.
notes: Food safety: salmon should reach 63°C; use fresh glaze for serving, not the portion that touched raw fish; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours.
Contains fish, soy, gluten and sesame.

recipes.title: BBQ Halloumi and Vegetable Skewers with Couscous
recipes.summary: Grilled halloumi, zucchini and capsicum skewers with lemony couscous and mint yoghurt.
steps: Thread the halloumi and vegetables onto skewers and brush with the oil and oregano.

Pour the boiling water over the couscous, cover for 5 minutes until fluffy and fork through the lemon juice. Grill the skewers over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, turning, until charred and the halloumi is golden.
Stir the mint into the yoghurt and serve with the skewers and couscous.
notes: Contains milk and gluten. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: One-Pot Chicken and Chorizo Paella-Style Rice
recipes.summary: Rice, chicken and chorizo simmered with paprika and peas for an easy weeknight paella.
steps: Brown the chicken and chorizo in the oil for 8 minutes until golden and the chicken reaches 75°C, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic for 4 minutes and stir in the paprika.
Add the rice and stock, bring to a simmer and cook gently, uncovered and without stirring, for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed. Scatter on the peas for the last 3 minutes.
Rest covered for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.
notes: Food safety: chicken and chorizo must reach 75°C with no pink; refrigerate rice within 1 hour and leftovers within 2 hours, and reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: One-Pot Creamy Garlic Prawn and Spinach Orzo
recipes.summary: Orzo cooks in garlicky stock and finishes with cream, spinach and quick prawns.
steps: Sear the prawns in half the oil for 2 minutes until pink and set aside.
Cook the garlic in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, add the orzo and stock and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring often, until tender and mostly absorbed.
Stir in the cream, spinach, lemon and salt for 2 minutes until wilted, then return the prawns for 1 minute.
notes: Food safety: cook prawns until pink and opaque; refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours and eat within 1 day.
Contains gluten, milk and crustacean shellfish.

recipes.title: Freezer-to-Table Turkey Meatballs in Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Batch-cooked turkey meatballs in tomato sauce that go from freezer to table in 30 minutes.
steps: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, half the garlic, oregano and salt and roll into 24 meatballs. Brown in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the onion, tomatoes and remaining garlic and simmer for 15 minutes until the meatballs reach 75°C and the sauce is thick. Cool within 1 hour, portion and freeze for up to 3 months.
Reheat from frozen, covered, over low heat for 25 minutes, stirring, until steaming hot. Boil the spaghetti for 10 minutes until al dente and serve.
notes: Food safety: turkey mince must reach 75°C right through with no pink; reheat only once until steaming hot (75°C), do not refreeze and eat within 2 days of thawing.
Contains egg and gluten.

recipes.title: Freezer-to-Table Vegetable and Bean Chilli Bake
recipes.summary: A vegetarian chilli topped with cornbread-style crumbs, baked straight from frozen.
steps: Soften the onion, capsicum, zucchini and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes, stir in the spices, then add the tomatoes, beans and corn and simmer for 15 minutes until thick. Cool and spoon into a dish.
Scatter the polenta and cheese over the top and freeze, wrapped, for up to 3 months.
Bake from frozen, covered, at 190°C (170°C fan) for 45 minutes, then uncovered for 15 minutes until golden and hot in the centre.
notes: Contains milk. Cool before freezing and reheat only once until steaming hot (75°C).
